#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_wc.py — wc.py 测试套件:6 个用例覆盖正常/空文件/仅空格/异常参数/--json 结构。"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

WC = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "wc.py")
PASS = 0
FAIL = 0


def run(args, stdin=""):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, WC] + args, input=stdin.encode(), capture_output=True)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout.decode(), r.stderr.decode()


def case(name, cond):
    global PASS, FAIL
    if cond:
        PASS += 1
        print(f"ok {name}")
    else:
        FAIL += 1
        print(f"FAIL {name}")


rc, out, _ = run([], "a b\nc d e")
case("normal_lines2_words5_bytes9", rc == 0 and "lines=2" in out and "words=5" in out and "bytes=9" in out)

rc, out, _ = run([], "")
case("empty_all_zero", rc == 0 and "lines=0" in out and "words=0" in out and "bytes=0" in out)

rc, out, _ = run([], "   \n  \t ")
case("spaces_only_words0_bytes8", rc == 0 and "words=0" in out and "bytes=8" in out)

rc, out, err = run(["--no-such-flag"])
case("bad_arg_exit2_usage", rc == 2 and "usage" in (err or "").lower())

rc, out, _ = run(["--json"], "1 2\n")
try:
    d = json.loads(out)
    ok = rc == 0 and d["lines"] == 1 and d["words"] == 2 and d["bytes"] == 4
except Exception:
    ok = False
case("json_structure", ok)

rc, out, _ = run(["-l"], "x\ny\n")
case("only_lines_flag", rc == 0 and out.strip() == "lines=2")

print(f"tests={PASS + FAIL} pass={PASS} failures={FAIL}")
sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)

"""fixed.py — 修复 buggy.py 的 ①语法错误 ②名称错误 ③逻辑 bug(range 差一)。"""


def total(n):                    # ① 补冒号
    s = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):    # ③ 修差一:1..n 闭区间
        s += i
    return s


def report(n):
    summation = total(n)         # ② 拼写修正
    print(f"sum({n}) = {summation}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    report(10)
    assert total(10) == 55, "logic bug still here"
    assert total(0) == 0
    assert total(1) == 1
    print("FIXED")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lru_mt.py — threading.Lock 保护的多线程安全 LRU;2 线程并发读写验证一致性。"""
import threading
from collections import OrderedDict


class LRUCacheMT:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.cap = capacity
        self.data = OrderedDict()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def get(self, key):
        with self.lock:
            if key not in self.data:
                return -1
            self.data.move_to_end(key)
            return self.data[key]

    def put(self, key, value):
        with self.lock:
            if key in self.data:
                self.data.move_to_end(key)
            self.data[key] = value
            if len(self.data) > self.cap:
                self.data.popitem(last=False)


cache = LRUCacheMT(128)
hits = [0, 0]
LOOPS = 2000


def worker(idx):
    for i in range(LOOPS):
        cache.put(i % 50, i)
        v = cache.get(i % 50)
        if v != -1:
            hits[idx] += 1


t1 = threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(0,))
t2 = threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(1,))
t1.start()
t2.start()
t1.join()
t2.join()

final_count = len(cache.data)
assert final_count <= 128, f"capacity broken: {final_count}"
assert sum(hits) == 2 * LOOPS, f"lost updates: hits={sum(hits)}"
print(f"race_ok final_count={final_count} hits={sum(hits)}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""extract.py — 从 sample_log.txt 一次提取手机号/IP/时间戳 → extracted.log(每行一项)。"""
import os
import re

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
with open(os.path.join(HERE, "sample_log.txt"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
    text = f.read()

phones = sorted(set(re.findall(r"1[3-9]\d{9}", text)))
ips = sorted(set(re.findall(r"(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}", text)))
stamps = sorted(set(re.findall(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}", text)))

with open(os.path.join(HERE, "extracted.log"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for v in phones + ips + stamps:
        f.write(v + "\n")
print(f"extracted phones={len(phones)} ips={len(ips)} stamps={len(stamps)}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""re_demo.py — 4 组正则各 3 断言:手机号 / IPv4 形状 / 时间戳 / 邮箱。"""
import re

PHONE = re.compile(r"^1[3-9]\d{9}$")
IPV4 = re.compile(r"^(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$")
TS = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$")
EMAIL = re.compile(r"^[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.-]+$")

cases = [
    (PHONE, "13912345678", True),
    (PHONE, "12345678901", False),
    (PHONE, "139123456789", False),
    (IPV4, "192.168.1.1", True),
    (IPV4, "256.1.1.1", True),
    (IPV4, "1.2.3", False),
    (TS, "2026-09-11 10:30:00", True),
    (TS, "2026-9-11 10:30:00", False),
    (TS, "2026-09-11 10:30", False),
    (EMAIL, "user.name+tag@example.com", True),
    (EMAIL, "bad@@example.com", False),
    (EMAIL, "no-at-sign.example.com", False),
]
for pat, s, want in cases:
    got = bool(pat.match(s))
    assert got == want, f"{s!r}: want {want} got {got}"
    print(f"OK {s!r} -> {got}")
print("regex_ok")
